newsitem.title: USA: Florida newlyweds end up in neck braces.
newsitem.headline: Florida newlyweds end up in neck braces.

text.p: A car rear-ended a horse-drawn carriage leaving a wedding, sending the bride flying through the air in her white gown.
Candace Whitaker and groom Richard Waters Jr. ended up in neck braces in hospital after a car struck their carriage as they left church on Saturday night, the Orlando Sentinel said.
The teenager driving the carriage was also hurt. The horse suffered a broken leg and had to be put down.
"It was a devastating sight to see a beautiful bride in a white wedding dress strapped to an ambulance stretcher," said Rev. Alan Brindisi, who performed the wedding.
